statement: ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 1 f → Summable (fun k => ‖f k‖) ∧ (∑' k, ‖f k‖) ≤ (1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹)) * KdVPlan.hn 1 f
proof:
intro f hf
let D := KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹)
have HD : 0 ≤ D := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have H := (yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 f hf
have HI := yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 (KdVPlan.dx f) H.2.1
have hs := yui_aux_0012 T gamma R h_T013 ‖f 0‖
have he : (fun k => ‖f k‖) = (fun k => (if k = 0 then ‖f 0‖ else 0) + ‖KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.dx f) k‖) := by
 funext k
 by_cases hk : k = 0
 · simp [hk, KdVPlan.invD]
 · have hki : Complex.I * (k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hk)
   rw [(yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).1 (KdVPlan.dx f) k |>.1]
   simp only [KdVPlan.dx]
   rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hki]
   simp [hk]
have hpt : ‖f 0‖ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 1 f := by
 let x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := ⟨f, (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 f).1.mp H.1.1⟩
 have hnorm : KdVPlan.hn 0 f = ‖x‖ := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 f).2 _
 exact (lp.norm_apply_le_norm (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0) x 0).trans (hnorm ▸ H.1.2)
refine ⟨he ▸ hs.1.add HI.2.1, ?_⟩
calc
 (∑' k, ‖f k‖) = ‖f 0‖ + ∑' k, ‖KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.dx f) k‖ := by rw [he, hs.1.tsum_add HI.2.1, hs.2]
 _ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 1 f + D * KdVPlan.hn 1 f := add_le_add hpt (HI.2.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H.2.2 HD))
 _ = (1 + D) * KdVPlan.hn 1 f := by ring
